name: Charleroi

queries.query: Charleroi Belgium official cadastral parcel map viewer GIS parcels site:charleroi.be OR site:finances.belgium.be OR site:geo.be
queries.result: First-party discovery found the official FPS Finance cadastral-plan guidance, CadGIS viewer metadata, and Charleroi municipal cadastral-map references in official property documents. FPS Finance states that CadGIS is the public map for Belgian parcels and that cadastral-plan web services provide WMS/WFS access.

queries.query: Charleroi Belgique carte cadastrale parcelles officielle géomatique cadastre site:charleroi.be OR site:finances.belgium.be OR site:geo.be
queries.result: First-party French-language discovery found SPF Finances guidance for the Belgian cadastral plan, CadGIS viewer metadata identifying AGDP as custodian and national scope, and official Charleroi documents showing cadastral parcel maps. No separate Charleroi-owned anonymous parcel feature API was evidenced.

officialSourceAssessment.localCustodian: The Ville de Charleroi official site and municipal property documents evidence local use of cadastral maps, but no city-owned current parcel feature service was found.
officialSourceAssessment.nationalOrRegionalCustodian: SPF Finances / AGDP is the Belgian cadastral-plan custodian. The CadGIS metadata describes national cadastral-plan viewing and spatial queries; federal guidance identifies public WMS/WFS services.
officialSourceAssessment.registryFoundReason: An official federal cadastral viewer/service and official local Charleroi cadastral-map references were evidenced. This is source evidence only and does not qualify a production adapter.
